hypotheses.claim: FRANK recurrent trajectory formation should remain independently observable from halt/readout policy; initial adaptive recurrence should be evaluated with a post-hoc proposal-only readout over frozen trajectories before allowing a controller to shape the trajectory itself.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Because current FRANK readouts are deterministic proposal-only functions rather than jointly trained neural gates, trajectory/readout entanglement may be negligible and explicit separation may add instrumentation cost without measurable benefit.
hypotheses.falsifier: Frozen-replay and live matched-budget experiments show no material difference in diagnostic power, false-halt rate, trajectory quality, latency or recovery between independent post-hoc readout and controller-coupled variants.
hypotheses.next_test: Matched frozen episodes: fixed recurrence budget versus post-hoc adaptive readout versus deliberately controller-coupled trajectory; compare task outcome, false halt, recurrence count, latency and state-trajectory divergence.

hypotheses.claim: HALT_CANDIDATE_CONVERGED must not be minted from low residual pressure alone; it requires low state change as well, and a short persistence streak is a useful anti-single-frame guard in H1.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Low residual pressure may justify stopping even while state changes materially, but that should be represented as a distinct stop reason rather than fixed-point convergence.
hypotheses.falsifier: A clearly defined non-fixed-point stop semantic is shown to dominate the joint low-delta/low-residual criterion without increasing false convergence labels; in that case convergence and generic stopping must remain separate labels.
hypotheses.next_test: Run repository CI plus Ubuntu replay traces with high-delta/low-residual, low-delta/high-residual, transient-low-delta and genuine-convergence trajectories.

hypotheses.claim: Residual estimator identity, freshness and self-reported uncertainty are necessary but insufficient for promotion; estimator calibration must be measured against downstream false-halt/regret outcomes across loop families, regimes and OOD episodes.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: For H1 proposal-only diagnostics, the existing uncertainty and freshness checks may already be sufficient, and calibration should not block instrumentation or early replay research.
hypotheses.falsifier: Across held-out and OOD replay, uncalibrated residual metadata performs equivalently to calibrated sequential criteria on false halt, outcome regret and compute under matched budgets.
hypotheses.next_test: Shadow calibration benchmark: at each recurrence step record residual estimate, uncertainty, actual eventual resolution and oracle/fixed-budget outcome; measure false halt, regret, empirical coverage/calibration and compute, stratified by loop family and truthful/shuffled/no-reentry controls.

negative_results.statement: Low residual pressure alone is not a valid fixed-point convergence criterion in the H1 loop quality gate because it can coexist with materially changing state.
Repository/CI integrity evidence is insufficient to claim Andreas Ubuntu target installation and runtime acceptance; target-host execution receipts remain separately required.
